title: The Advanced Circuit Canon
summary: A canon that turns the full circuit into a great wheel of qi for crushing strokes and a guard that never breaks its turn.

title: A Treatise on Qi Beyond the Body
summary: A treatise on holding qi as a living field beyond the skin that feels strikes and guards at a distance.

title: The Heavy Pulse Compendium
summary: A compendium of slow weighty pulses of qi that break guards and break the rhythm of those who stand against them.

title: The Living Field Manual
summary: A manual of the living field of qi that mends and quickens allies standing within it and clears what taints their channels.

title: The Paired Circuit Canon
summary: A canon of running two circuits of qi in step so each arm answers the other in strike and guard.

title: Treatise of the Hawk-Eyed Qi
summary: A treatise on keen qi sight and plunging strokes that also teaches the recalling of a breath that has just stopped.

title: Manual of the Two Fields
summary: A manual of an inner field for strength and an outer field for guarding with the two fields traded in a breath.

title: The Sworn Breath Canon
summary: A canon that binds every strike and guard to a breath sworn before it begins and held until it is spent.

title: Treatise on the Held Bearing of Qi
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing with the qi and holding it through every exchange so no blow turns the line.

title: The Oath Field Compendium
summary: A compendium of the oath-field of qi that shelters those sworn within it and strikes outward from its edge.
